description: Accommodations for students with chronic pain conditions, chronic fatigue syndrome, fibromyalgia, or similar conditions affecting stamina and concentration
specific_accommodations: Permission to stand, stretch, or change position during class
Access to ergonomic seating or cushions
Rest breaks during long exams (10 minutes per hour)
Option to split exams across multiple sessions
Reduced course load to manage energy levels
Flexible attendance policy for flare-up days
Priority early registration to minimize walking between classes
Parking accommodation for days when walking is difficult
Extension of assignment deadlines during severe pain episodes
Option to attend classes remotely on high-pain days
documentation_required: Letter from treating physician or pain specialist
notes: Student should communicate with instructors about pain management needs. May require coordination with campus health services for emergency support.
